subtitle: Digital versatility - hundreds of amps, effects, and possibilities in one package

introduction.title: Modeling Amplifiers: The Digital Revolution
introduction.text: Experience the power of digital modeling - access legendary amplifiers, effects, and sounds from music history.

columns.title: What You'll Learn
columns.text: How digital modeling technology recreates classic amps. Advantages of modeling for modern musicians. Best modeling amps for different needs and budgets. Getting great tones from modeling technology. Integration with modern recording and performance setups.

cards.title: Digital Signal Processing
cards.description: Modeling amps use sophisticated digital algorithms to simulate the behavior of classic amplifiers, speakers, and effects down to the component level.
items: Circuit modeling: Simulates tube and transistor behavior
Speaker simulation: Models cabinet and speaker response

cards.title: Advanced Algorithms
cards.description: Modern modeling uses machine learning and advanced mathematics to capture the nuances of analog amplification.
items: Impulse responses: Precise speaker cabinet modeling

cards.title: Versatility
cards.description: Access hundreds of amplifier models, effects, and speaker cabinets in a single unit, covering every genre and era of music.

cards.title: Modern Features
cards.description: Modeling amps offer features impossible in analog amplifiers, perfect for modern recording and performance needs.

cards.title: Practicality
cards.description: Perfect for home practice, recording, and venues where volume control and consistency are important.

cards.title: Analog Modeling
cards.description: Uses analog circuits to approximate tube and transistor behavior. Simpler but effective approach.
items: Circuit-based: Analog components mimic tube response
Natural feel: Responds like analog circuits

cards.title: Digital Modeling
cards.description: Computer-based processing that can model any amplifier with extreme accuracy and flexibility.
items: Updateable: New models via firmware updates
